goal: open Hacker News 'past', then wait until the front page is gone

steps.title: Hacker News
steps.note: the browser window: its title is 'Hacker News - Google Chrome' (Edge: '... - Microsoft Edge')

the top-bar link; an exact OCR item wins over story titles that contain the word. confirm_frames: act only if the match holds on the next frame too. OCR may read the top bar as one line ('new | past | comments | ...'): then 'past' only matches that line as a substring and the act would click its centre (another link). Dry-run first and look up the id in the row's confirm_frames among the stamp's items; if it is the whole bar, use norm
the front page title starts with 'Hacker News'; other pages are '<page> | Hacker News - ...'. contains would match those too and never become true
